technology_name: Plant Tissue Culture Protocols for High-Value Crops: Disease-Free Mass Propagation Method
institution: KSCSTE- Jawaharlal Nehru Tropical Botanic Garden & Research Institute (JNTBGRI)
problem_solved: Absence of standardized mass propagation protocols and clean planting stock for emerging, rare, and high-value plant species.
description: Jawaharlal Nehru Tropical Botanic Garden & Research Institute (JNTBGRI) has developed standardized plant tissue culture protocols for the mass propagation of high-value crops, including banana, orchids, anthuriums, and medicinal plants. This technology delivers high-quality, disease-free, and true-to-type planting material. It addresses the global demand for clean planting stock by providing a scalable and sustainable method for the mass propagation of rare, high-value, and endangered species. The protocols are designed to support the pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, herbal wellness, horticulture, and biodiversity conservation sectors.
applications:
• Mass propagation of disease-free planting material for the horticulture and agriculture sectors

• Cultivation of standardized medicinal plants for pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and herbal wellness industries

• Biodiversity conservation and reforestation through the mass propagation of rare and endangered species

• Commercial nursery operations and rural entrepreneurship via scalable tissue culture deployment
